headline: Huawei sanctioned in US for business with Iran
summary: A Brooklyn jury found Chinese group Huawei guilty of bank fraud and theft of trade secrets, ending a legal process of more than eight years. The case concerns business dealings with Iran.
why: Huawei is a major Chinese telecommunications equipment and smartphone maker, and US sanctions and legal actions against it affect its global supply chain and access to Western markets.
original_headline: Huawei es sancionada en EU por negocios con Irán
